blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Metro Cebu Collegiate Basketball League (MCCBL) enters its second season with a bigger field, longer format, and more venues as it continues to provide a competitive platform for schools and universities outside the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi). Season 2 officially tips off on October 10 at the Cordova Sports Complex, with the league expanding with more teams. Joining the league are Indiana Aerospace University (IAU) and Cordova-Catholic Cooperative School (CCCS).
